complete_examples.text: In this example, the wheel–rail vertical and lateral interactions are, respectively, validated by comparing with classical Hertzian contact theory and FastSim by Kalker (1982).

It can be clearly observed that although there exist deviations with respect to the wheel–rail lateral forces of this model and FastSim, the differences are actually very small in engineering practices.
